## s12-v15 — argument map

Reveal (prakāśaya) the abode (sadanaṃ) — Lord, Your city (tava puram). May I see (paśyeyam) the abode where You dwell. Reveal the abode: may I see where You dwell.

### Open
- Whether 'prakāśaya' is imperative or optative is unresolved.
- Whether 'sadanaṃ' means 'abode' or 'house' is unresolved.
